title: Register a new account
label: new
iNeed: to register with my name, email, and password
soThat: I can use my own Second Chance account
assumptions: An email address can belong to only one account.
then: my account is created and I receive a successful response

title: Sign in to an existing account
label: new
iNeed: to sign in with my email and password
soThat: I can manage my account and shared items
assumptions: The account has already been registered.
when: I submit the correct email and password
then: I receive a successful login response and an authentication token

title: Browse available items
label: backlog
soThat: I can find something useful to reuse
given: items are available in the database
then: the available items are displayed with their names and categories

title: View an item's details
label: backlog
iNeed: to open an item's full details
soThat: I can decide whether the item suits my needs
assumptions: Each item has a unique identifier.
when: I request the item by its identifier
then: I see its name, description, category, and other saved details

title: Search items and filter by category
label: backlog
iNeed: to search by a keyword and choose a category
soThat: I can quickly find relevant items
assumptions: Items have a name, description, and category.
when: I search for a keyword and select a category
then: only items matching the search and category are returned

title: Share an item with an image
label: new
iNeed: to upload an item with its details and an image
soThat: someone else can give it a second chance
assumptions: The upload field is named file.
given: I am signed in and have an item to share
when: I submit the item details and an image
then: the item is saved and can be viewed in the item list

title: Delete an item I shared
label: technical debt
iNeed: to delete an item that is no longer available
assumptions: Only an item's owner may delete it.
Invalid or missing item identifiers return a clear error.
given: I am signed in and own an existing item
when: I delete that item by its identifier
then: the item is removed and no longer appears in the list

title: Update my profile information
label: icebox
assumptions: A user may update only their own account.
when: I submit valid changes to my profile
then: my updated information is saved and returned without my password
